items.ve: Mutukana o vhudzisa khotsi awe: 'Ndi ngani vhurotho vhu tshi dura?' Khotsi a ri: 'Ngauri vha vhu itaho vha na ndala.'
items.en: A boy asked his father why bread is expensive. The father said it is because the people who make it are hungry too.

items.ve: Mudededzi: 'Nwana wanga, u a divha uri duvha ndi mini?' Nwana: 'Ndi duvha.'
items.en: Teacher: 'Child, do you know what duvha means?' Child: 'It means duvha.'
